content: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Trustpilot, we're on an incredible journey. We're a profitable, high-growth FTSE-250 company with a big vision: to become the universal symbol of trust. We run the world's largest open customer review platform, and while we've come a long way, there's still so much exciting work to do. Come join us at the heart of trust!</p></div><p>The CX Governance &amp; Service Standards Manager within the Customer Experience Performance (CEP) team leads the design and governance of the future company-wide scaling of Trustpilot’s service standards, for service excellence and continuous improvement across Customer Experience &amp; Support (CES) and the wider Trustpilot organization. Leading the strategic function CX Governance &amp; Service Standards, this role drives Trustpilot’s evolution toward a proactive, closed-loop resolution engine. It leads the enterprise Voice of the Customer (VoC) governance rhythm, chairs the cross-functional Global VoC Forum, and directs the company-wide 'Fix the Basics' initiative to eliminate avoidable customer contacts at the root. Additionally, the role anchors service quality, governing<em> </em>The Trustpilot Experience: Service Standard while actively supporting any customer-facing teams across Trustpilot that would want to tailor and apply these standards to their specific operational workflows, systematically reducing customer effort and increasing the experience.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll be doing:</strong></p> <p>Global Voice of the Customer (VoC) Closed-Loop Governance</p> <ul> <li>VoC Forum Leadership: Chair, and direct the Global VoC Forum, bringing together cross-functional leadership across all operational, commercial, and technical business owners to drive collective ownership and end-to-end accountability for eliminating customer friction points.</li> <li>Closed-Loop Feedback Engine: Govern the "Listen-Analyze-Act-Monitor" lifecycle by translating end-to-end customer listening signals and contact diagnostics into validated, priorit

...fferings.</li> <li>Represent Trustpilot at key industry events and strengthen our brand in the region.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Who you are:</strong></h4> <ul> <li>A results-driven Enterprise SaaS seller with experience managing long, consultative sales cycles.</li> <li>Proven success closing complex, high-value deals involving procurement, legal, and executive-level decision makers.</li> <li>Fluent in both Swedish and English, comfortable in both formal boardroom settings and creative brainstorms.</li> <li>Organised, proactive, and curious, you thrive in roles that offer ownership and autonomy.</li> <li>Looking to move beyond a one-size-fits-all sales playbook and help shape something built for the European market.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>What’s in it for you:</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Real ownership: influence how we grow within your market</li> <li>Competitive compensation package + bonus</li> <li>25 days holiday with an additional 5 days after 12 months of continuous employment</li> <li>2 (paid) volunteering days a year to spend your time giving back to the causes that matter to you and your community</li> <li>Paid parental leave</li> <li>Comprehensive health package, pension, and full access to Headspace, a popular mindfulness app to promote positive mental health</li> <li>An international workspace at our HQ in Copenhagen that’s complete with a coffee bar and canteen, with a wide variety of refreshments available. You can opt in for breakfast and lunch at an affordable price.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Still not sure?</strong></h4> <p>We want to be a part of creating a more diverse, equitable, and inclusive world of work for all. We’re excited to hear about your experiences along with how you will contribute to our working culture. Even if you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, we'd still really like to hear from you!</p> <p class="p1">#LI-MN1</p><div class=&q

...s to drive strategic decisions.</li> <li>Serve as a technical advisor and subject-matter expert for the people team, enhancing data literacy across the function.</li> <li>Conduct both ad-hoc deep-dive analyses and maintain a regular reporting cadence.</li> <li>Partner with the Senior Director, Reward &amp; Analytics to enhance data tooling, warehousing, and governance.</li> <li>Provide backup and support to the Workforce Planning team during peak workloads or periods of leave.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who you are:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Strong background in data modelling, statistical analysis, and business intelligence (BI) and dashboarding tools.</li> <li>Proven ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage competing priorities effectively.</li> <li>Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to translate complex data and insights into clear, compelling recommendations for senior leaders and employees.</li> <li>Highly autonomous and self-motivated, with a strong aptitude for learning new concepts, tools, and skills quickly.</li> <li>Collaborative and service-oriented, with a strong focus on building trusted relationships and delivering solutions that meet the needs of stakeholders.</li> <li>Advanced proficiency in Google Sheets.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with Sage HR (Salesforce).</li> <li>Experience working with Looker and BigQuery.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What’s in it for you:</strong></p> <ul> <li>A range of flexible working options to dedicate time to what matters to you</li> <li>Competitive compensation package + bonus</li> <li>25 days holiday per year, increasing to 28 days after 2 years of employment&nbsp;</li> <li>Two (paid) volunteering days a year to spend your time giving back to the causes that matter to you and your community</li> <li>Rich learning and development opportunities are supported through the Trustpilot Academy and Blinkist</li>
